To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
CEOs are more concerned with operating issues than strategic issues and are generally unfamiliar and uninterested in academic research.
CEOs and academics have very different views of what is relevant for the future of the field of strategy research.
CEOs and academics differ in the importance they place on various issues in the field of strategic managment, in their familiarity with academic research, and in the types of journals they read.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the question, 'How relevant is strategy research to the practitioner?'.
the relevance of strategy research for practitioners.
the relevance of research in the field of strategic planning.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the relevance of strategy research is a function of the extent to which the research is perceived by managers to address their concerns and to provide them with the tools to improve their performance in the marketplace.
the field of strategy is relevant, but the relevance is not as great as it might be.
the field of strategy research has not been successful in achieving relevance for practitioners.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
strategy research should be more relevant to practitioners and more rigorous in its methods.
strategy research is important for managers, but that the field is in danger of losing touch with its professional orientation.
the relevance of strategy research is a complex issue that needs to be addressed in the future by both academics and practitioners.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the field of strategic research needs to develop a better way to connect with practitioners.
academics and practitioners need to communicate more with each other to ensure the continued relevance of strategy research.

the field needs to do a better job of communicating its findings to the business community and that the business community needs to do a more effective job of communicating their concerns to the research community.
